description: Rededicated in 2020 after restoration; sits in the memorial gardens at the former NAS Brunswick; the museum's own 2026 site presents it as a VP-8 aircraft circa 1978

Restoration completed July 2025 per the museum - the strongest currency evidence in this pass; the SilverHawk lead list gives BuNo 131427 instead but that airframe was scrapped at Quonset in May 2018 so 128392 is used
